questions.question: Mina, now a national endodontic reference, is invited to an international congress. What message should she carry?
options: Endodontics is a model of technical excellence
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Endodontics is a model of technical excellence.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Sami must create a foundation to promote endodontics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting tooth preservation is essential for the future.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Mina must write a reference book on endodontics. What is the central message?
options: Endodontics is an art that combines technique and rigor
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Endodontics is an art that combines technique and rigor.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Endodontics is evolving, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Endodontics is evolving, full of opportunities.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a mentoring program in endodontics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental endodontic skills.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Sami must manage the succession of his endodontic expertise. What is the best strategy?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Gradual preparation of transmission is the key to a successful succession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Mina must create an endodontic charter. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Rigor and disinfection are the pillars of any endodontic charter.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must train future endodontic mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Mina must prepare a testimony on her endodontic journey. What is the most striking element?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The joy of saving teeth is the most striking element.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an alumni association in endodontics. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the link and foster mutual support
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the driving forces of an alumni association.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Mina must write an article on the future of endodontics. What trend should be highlighted?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Innovation in service of precision is a promising trend.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a quality label for endodontics. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Quality of disinfection and obturation are the fundamental criteria.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The profession needs endodontic enthusiasts.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an award for young dentists in endodontics. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Endodontic excellence is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Mina must write her memoirs. What is the common thread to highlight?
options: The passion for endodontics and patient service
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The passion for endodontics is the common thread of a professional life.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an endodontic training center. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Training should produce tooth preservation professionals.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Endodontic skills and an example to follow
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Endodontic skills and an example to follow are the most beautiful legacy.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must write a letter to future dentists about endodontics. What message should it convey?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Endodontics is an exciting discipline.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a scholarship for endodontic students. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech. What note should he leave?
options: Endodontics continues to evolve with those who carry it
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Endodontics continues to evolve with those who carry it.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina must pass on her endodontic knowledge. What is the priority?
options: Sell her knowledge at the highest price
Transmit in the continuity of skills
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Transmission in the continuity of skills is the most beautiful success.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a peer network for young dentists in endodontics. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young dentists.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Mina must write a conclusion to her book. What is the final sentence?
options: Endodontics is a magnificent human adventure
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Endodontics is a magnificent human adventure.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must leave a message to future generations. What is the message?
options: Endodontics is a discipline worth experiencing
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Endodontics is a discipline worth experiencing.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina, after a life dedicated to endodontics, receives national recognition. Sami is by her side. What is Mina's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina concludes: 'Endodontics needs passion and rigor to continue evolving.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'
